title: Juris Corp inducts four homegrown lawyers into Equity Partnership
description: Juris Corp has announced the induction of Saurabh Sharma, Apurva Kanvinde, Ankit Sinha and Smrithi Nair into the Firm's Equity Partnership. Sharma is part of the Dispute Resolution & Insolvency, Financial Services, and Regulatory practice groups.
